info.title: GP Control Plane API
info.description: Alpha Core/Web split API contract for the headless runtime and штатный Web UI. The contract contains the registered /api/core, /api/service, /api/web and /openapi.json routes; legacy root-level APIs are removed before 1.0.

servers.description: Current Swagger origin. When opened from Web UI it uses the board address; when opened from Core it uses the local Core address.

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description: Create and rotate the Bearer token used by protected API operations.

tags.name: Core Strategy Discovery
tags.description: Start, stop, progress, logs and preflight for strategy discovery.

tags.name: Core Presets
tags.description: Domain lists and v2fly-assisted domain selection.

tags.name: Core Backups
tags.description: Backup, upload, download and restore of internal GP data.

tags.name: Core Clean-Install Vault
tags.description: One pending device-local vault used only by the explicit clean-install recovery flow.

tags.name: Core Runs
tags.description: Full run history, run logs and strategy candidates.

tags.name: Core Settings
tags.description: Settings that affect real strategy discovery runs.

tags.name: Service Status
tags.description: Installed GP service and data state.

tags.name: Service Releases
tags.description: Read-only information about available GP releases. Installation is performed only by the explicit clean-install procedure outside this API.

tags.name: Service V2fly
tags.description: Local v2fly storage status and update actions.

tags.name: Web Slices
tags.description: Штатный Web UI optimized list slices, pagination and screen-specific views.

get.description: Public health check. It does not require a Bearer token.

post.description: Public login endpoint. Use the returned access token as `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>` for protected operations.

post.summary: Change the admin password and rotate Bearer tokens
post.description: Requires a valid Bearer token. On success, all previous tokens are invalidated and a replacement token is returned.

200.description: Password changed and replacement Bearer token created

get.description: Answers what the GP product core is doing now: current discovery run, core jobs and product runtime state.

post.description: Routes a discovery request by mode. The request contains final concrete domains and settings, not a preset id or live preset link.

post.summary: Stop the current strategy discovery run

200.description: Current run progress or idle state

get.summary: Get latest log tail for the current run

get.description: Checks GP/zapret/v2fly prerequisites needed to start discovery. It reports product readiness, not OS monitoring metrics.
Returns only real stored lists: required first, desired second, then user lists in storage order.

post.description: Saves one required, desired or user domain list. The list contents replace the previous contents of that list.

Deletes only explicitly listed user-created domain lists. The list_ids array must not be empty; to delete all user lists, the caller must enumerate every user list id. Required and desired lists cannot be deleted by this method.

get.description: Returns local v2fly categories and storage state. If storage is not prepared, the response is still 200 with storage.state=missing.

get.summary: Get domains from one v2fly category

post.description: Restores the selected snapshot synchronously after UI/client confirmation. There is no separate restore-preview endpoint in the target contract; the response is sent only after the restore succeeds.

202.description: Restore completed synchronously. The server currently returns HTTP 202 for this completed action.

post.description: Accepts a ZIP backup, validates structure, checksum and compatibility, then imports it into backup storage.

post.summary: Create the one pending device-local clean-install vault
post.description: Creates one pending device-local vault. Its local handoff remains on this device; the response contains public metadata only.

201.description: Pending vault created; response contains public metadata only.

get.summary: Get public status of one pending clean-install vault

post.summary: Restore and delete a verified pending clean-install vault
post.description: Requires explicit confirmation. The operation completes only after semantic verification, SQLite readiness/integrity verification and deletion of the source vault. Failed paths retain vault and handoff.

200.description: Restore was verified and the source vault was deleted.

get.description: Returns product run history without UI pagination. UI slices belong to /api/web/...

get.summary: Get latest log tail for a run

get.description: Returns normalized product candidate data only for filtered requests. At least one filter is required. Use /api/core/strategy-candidates/export for full streaming export.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: Exact domain name. Returns candidates linked to this domain.

parameters.name: domains
parameters.description: Comma-separated domain names. Returns candidates linked to any listed domain.

parameters.name: protocol
parameters.description: Strategy protocol or transport, for example tcp, quic or tls.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Text search across id, protocol, args, family and linked domains.

get.description: Streams one StrategyCandidate JSON object per line. This endpoint can be called without filters for a full export; optional filters use the same semantics as /api/core/strategy-candidates. It is intended for large exports and external clients.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: Exact domain name. Returns candidates linked to this domain.

parameters.name: domains
parameters.description: Comma-separated domain names. Returns candidates linked to any listed domain.

parameters.name: protocol
parameters.description: Strategy protocol or transport, for example tcp, quic or tls.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Text search across id, protocol, args, family and linked domains.

200.description: NDJSON stream with one strategy candidate per line

get.description: Answers whether the installed GP service and its data/install state are alive.
Returns Web-owned system diagnostics, including zapret2 readiness for the System card. Core status remains limited to product runtime state.

get.summary: Get Web UI run form preferences
get.description: Returns only штатный Web UI form state. Core start-run receives explicit domains and run parameters, not this saved UI state.

post.summary: Save Web UI run form preferences
post.description: Stores штатный Web UI form state for the next browser session. This does not start discovery and does not change durable Core results.

get.summary: Get a paginated run history page for штатный Web UI
Get a paginated candidate domain index page for the Web UI
Get a paginated strategy candidates page for штатный Web UI
Get Web UI preset metadata and lists
get.description: Returns штатный Web UI preset metadata plus built-in domain set labels. Domains for custom presets are included only when requested.

get.summary: Get a paginated Web UI preset domain page

post.summary: Save a Web UI preset domain list
Delete Web UI user preset lists

get.summary: Get a штатный Web UI event slice

get.description: Server-sent event stream for live Web UI refreshes. Event names match the Web UI event types returned by /api/web/events.

AuthenticationRequired.description: Bearer authentication is required or the supplied token is invalid

WWW-Authenticate.description: Bearer authentication challenge emitted by the server

error.message: The operation is unavailable while discovery is running.

kind.description: Runtime execution kind that identifies the discovery workflow which produced the run.

timestamp.description: Timestamp recorded for this run history entry; for the initial entry it is the run start time.
